ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity black pixels (~95%) with sparse, high-intensity white pixel clusters and linear streaks across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Multiple high-contrast white focal points scattered across both lobes; a cluster of high-intensity linear streaks on the left lobe (distal-mid region); a concentrated high-intensity irregular patch on the lower-right margin near the peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire margin; pixel-amplitude of variations is greater on the distal thirds of both lobes, characterized by sharp peaks and deep irregular valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex curve along the superior margin, transitioning to sharp, slightly concave distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 15-20 distinct, roughly circular white pixel clusters (2-8 pixel radii) scattered bilaterally, consistent with barnacle scar morphology.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the left lobe, including three prominent diagonal marks and several shorter horizontal segments.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular depigmentation patch on the lower-right fluke margin; several deep, non-uniform notches on the outer trailing edges suggesting historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique parallel-set of four high-contrast linear marks on the outer-left lobe.
